poll_period.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The poll period to apply, e.g. the short form `openthread.set_poll_period: 5s`.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

set_poll_period.docs: Sets the poll period at runtime on an MTD device. When `poll_period` > 0 the radio is off while idle (sleepy end device); when 0 the radio is always on. This action is a no-op on FTD devices.

device_type.docs:
**enum**: OpenThread Device Type, either `FTD` or `MTD`. Defaults to `FTD`. On nRF52840 this selects the matching Nordic prebuilt OpenThread library.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

ext_pan_id.docs:
**string**: 8-byte Extended Personal Area Network ID (XPAN ID).

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

force_dataset.docs:
**bool**: Forces ESPHome to override any OpenThread network dataset previously stored on the device, ensuring the configured dataset is applied at startup. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

mesh_local_prefix.docs:
**ipv6network**: Used to build Mesh-Local IPv6 addresses (ML-EIDs), which are unique to each Thread device within the network partition.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

output_power.docs:
**integer**: The amount of TX power for the Thread 802.15.4 radio in dBm. Range depends on the chip variant: ESP32-C5/C6 from `-15dBm` to `20dBm`, ESP32-H2 from `-24dBm` to `20dBm`. Defaults to the platform default (typically `0dBm`). Ensure the configured value complies with local regulatory limits.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

pan_id.docs:
**string**: 2-byte Personal Area Network ID (PAN ID).

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

poll_period.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: When set on an MTD device, the parent router enqueues any messages and waits for the child to submit a poll data request.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

pskc.docs:
**string**: PSKc is used to authenticate an external Thread Commissioner to a Thread network.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

tlv.docs:
**string**: The Thread dataset as a hex-encoded TLV string, taken from the Thread information in Home Assistant. **Required** on nRF52840.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*

use_address.docs:
**string**: Manually override the address used to connect to the device. Defaults to an auto-generated value.

*See also: [OpenThread Component](https://esphome.io/components/openthread#configuration-variables)*
